class.name: rviz_tools/Pose3DTool
class.description: 3D Pose Estimate Tool — click and drag to set initial pose. Publishes to /initialpose with full 3D position (including Z) via OpenGL depth picking.

class.name: rviz_tools/Goal3DTool
class.description: 3D Nav Goal Tool — click and drag to send a navigation goal. Publishes to /goal_3d with full 3D position (including Z) via OpenGL depth picking.
